title: The Garden
summary: Hypixel's Garden - your own 480 by 480 farm with 24 plots to unlock, Garden levels, crop milestones, visitors and their Copper, the Composter, SkyMart, pests and Jacob's Farming Contests.

You build and farm only on plots you've unlocked (anyone else visiting can look, not touch). The sidebar shows which plot you're on.
Unlock plots at the Desk, in Hypixel's order (the first four around the Barn, then the corners of that ring, then the outer ring). Each costs Compost, later Compost Bundles, and needs a Garden level:
and 5 SkyBlock XP. A fresh plot is overgrown with grass, flowers, rocks and the odd tree: clear it to farm it. Compost and other costs come out of your inventory or your sacks.

Garden XP raises the Garden level, I to XV (Hypixel's table: 70 XP for level II up to 10,000 a level from XI on, 60,120 in all). Each level gives 10 SkyBlock XP and lets visitors ask for more crops. Garden XP comes from

Harvesting the ten Garden crops on your plots counts toward their milestones: Wheat, Carrot, Potato, Pumpkin, Melon, Sugar Cane, Cactus, Cocoa Beans, Mushrooms and Nether Wart. Each broken crop counts as Hypixel's base drop (Carrots and Potatoes 3, Melons 5, Cocoa 3, Nether Wart 2.5, the rest 1) times your Farming Fortune. Milestones go up to level 46, on Hypixel's thresholds (Wheat 30 for the first level, Carrots 100, Melons 150...). Each milestone level gives
and 1 SkyBlock XP. The Desk's Milestones tab shows them all.
